in_hebrew.name: Jerman
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Soldier of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jerman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Ieremias', meaning 'Yahweh will raise'. This name was borne by the Old Testament prophet Jeremiah, who was called by God to be a messenger to the Israelites during a time of great crisis. The name Jerman symbolizes strength, courage, and faith in the face of adversity.
